package courseclient

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// DiagnosticCatalogClient holds the read-only capability for Course's
// diagnostic catalog. It is deliberately separate from the general token.
type DiagnosticCatalogClient struct {
	BaseURL, InternalToken string
	HTTPClient             *http.Client
}

func (client DiagnosticCatalogClient) GetDiagnosticAssessmentCatalog(ctx context.Context, courseID string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog, error) {
	if strings.TrimSpace(client.BaseURL) == "" || strings.TrimSpace(client.InternalToken) == "" || !canonicalCatalogUUID(courseID) {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, fmt.Errorf("diagnostic catalog client is not configured")
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, strings.TrimRight(client.BaseURL, "/")+"/internal/course/get-internal-diagnostic-assessments/"+courseID, nil)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, err
	}
	req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", client.InternalToken)
	hc := client.HTTPClient
	if hc == nil {
		hc = &http.Client{Timeout: 10 * time.Second}
	}
	safeClient := *hc
	safeClient.CheckRedirect = func(*http.Request, []*http.Request) error { return http.ErrUseLastResponse }
	resp, err := safeClient.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, err
	}
	defer func() { _ = resp.Body.Close() }()
	if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusNotFound {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	if resp.StatusCode == http.StatusForbidden || resp.StatusCode == http.StatusUnauthorized {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrForbidden
	}
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode > 299 {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, fmt.Errorf("course diagnostic catalog: %s", resp.Status)
	}
	media, _, contentErr := mime.ParseMediaType(resp.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if contentErr != nil || media != "application/json" {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	body, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 1<<20+1))
	if err != nil || len(body) > 1<<20 {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	dec := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
	dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var payload struct {
		Schema             string `json:"schema"`
		CourseID           string `json:"course_id"`
		CurriculumRevision string `json:"curriculum_revision"`
		Lessons            []struct {
			ID          string    `json:"id"`
			SectionID   string    `json:"section_id"`
			Title       string    `json:"title"`
			Description string    `json:"description"`
			UpdatedAt   time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
			CourseID    string    `json:"course_id"`
			Order       int       `json:"order"`
			Status      int       `json:"status"`
			Tasks       []struct {
				ID                string                     `json:"id"`
				Title             string                     `json:"title"`
				Description       string                     `json:"description"`
				EvaluationMode    string                     `json:"evaluation_mode"`
				LessonID          string                     `json:"lesson_id"`
				Type              int16                      `json:"type"`
				AssessmentPurpose string                     `json:"assessment_purpose"`
				Order             int                        `json:"order"`
				LearningTargets   []domain.LearningTargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
				UpdatedAt         time.Time                  `json:"updated_at"`
				Version           int64                      `json:"version"`
				Status            int                        `json:"status"`
			} `json:"tasks"`
		} `json:"lessons"`
	}
	if err = dec.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if err = dec.Decode(&struct{}{}); err != io.EOF {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	result := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{Schema: payload.Schema, CourseID: payload.CourseID, CurriculumRevision: payload.CurriculumRevision}
	if len(payload.Lessons) > 500 || !canonicalCatalogUUID(payload.CourseID) {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	seenLessons := map[string]bool{}
	seenTasks := map[string]bool{}
	itemCount := 0
	for _, lesson := range payload.Lessons {
		if !canonicalCatalogUUID(lesson.ID) || lesson.CourseID != payload.CourseID || lesson.Status != 1 || lesson.Order < 0 || seenLessons[lesson.ID] {
			return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrValidation
		}
		seenLessons[lesson.ID] = true
		for _, task := range lesson.Tasks {
			itemCount++
			targets, normalizeErr := domain.NormalizeDiagnosticLearningTargets(task.LearningTargets)
			if itemCount > 100 || !canonicalCatalogUUID(task.ID) || seenTasks[task.ID] || normalizeErr != nil || len(targets) == 0 || len(targets) > 100 || task.Version < 1 || task.UpdatedAt.IsZero() || task.LessonID != lesson.ID || task.Order < 0 || task.Status != 1 || task.AssessmentPurpose != "diagnostic" || task.EvaluationMode != "AUTO" || !validDiagnosticTaskType(task.Type) {
				return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrValidation
			}
			seenTasks[task.ID] = true
			result.Items = append(result.Items, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalogItem{LessonID: task.LessonID, TaskID: task.ID, TaskVersion: task.Version, UpdatedAt: task.UpdatedAt.UTC(), LessonOrder: lesson.Order, TaskOrder: task.Order, Type: task.Type, AssessmentPurpose: strings.TrimSpace(task.AssessmentPurpose), LearningTargets: targets})
		}
	}
	if result.Schema != "course-diagnostic-assessment-catalog.v1" || result.CourseID != courseID || itemCount == 0 || !diagnosticCatalogDigest(result.CurriculumRevision) {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog{}, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return result, nil
}
func diagnosticCatalogDigest(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != 71 || !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value[7:] {
		if !strings.ContainsRune("0123456789abcdef", r) {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validDiagnosticTaskType(value int16) bool {
	switch value {
	case 11, 12, 13:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}
func canonicalCatalogUUID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value
}
